title: Mikrotik security advisory (AV26-887)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-887 Date: September 8, 2026 As of September 5, 2026, Mikrotik is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: RouterOS Prior to 6.49.21 Prior to 7.23.4 Prior to 7.24.2 Prior to 7.25 beta 3 Open-source reporting indicates that CVE-2026-67276, CVE-2026-67277 and CVE-2026-86060 related to MikroTik are being exploited in the wild. The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Vulnerabilities in Mikrotik RouterOS software September 2026 vulnerability Article Link: Mikrotik security advisory (AV26-887) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
